submitted.rationale: EQE falls off toward Sb-rich (0.0017% at Sb 0.51, 0.0037% at 0.72). The Fe-rich side is best: 0.0091% at 0.17, 0.0098% at 0.26. Aside from Pt substrate peaks, XRD shows hematite plus rutile FeSbO4 at Sb 0.21–0.26. There is only a hematite-like peak at 0.17 and only rutile at 0.31 and above. The flat EQE between 0.17 and 0.26 pointed to a maximum between them, so I measured index 4 (Sb 0.233). It gave the highest EQE, 0.0125%.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.0017%, single-phase rutile FeSbO4 is poor
